title: Laboratory Test Orders: Rejection Notice and Recollection Allowances by Service Class
content:
When a specimen on a Laboratory Test Orders accession is rejected, four settings of the accession's service class apply: the notice period, the class recollection window, the number of no-charge recollections and whether a recollection needs a new requisition.

| Service class | Notice of rejection (business days) | Class recollection window (calendar days after the rejection date) | Maximum recollection requests per order | New requisition needed for a recollection |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | 1 | 14 | 2 | No |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | 1 | 14 | 2 | No |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | 2 | 21 | 2 | No |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | 1 | 7 | 2 | No |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | 1 | 7 | 1 | No |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | 1 | 0 | 0 | Yes |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | 2 | 30 | 2 | No |

## Meaning of each column

- **Notice of rejection** — the business days after a rejection within which the patient and the ordering provider are notified.
- **Class recollection window** — the class's number of calendar days after the rejection date through which a no-charge recollection may be collected; 0 means the class offers no recollection.
- **Maximum recollection requests per order** — the most recollection requests one order may receive.
- **New requisition needed** — whether a recollection needs a new requisition, and therefore a new order, from the provider.

## Reading the schedule

- Anatomic Pathology & Cytology is the only class with no recollection: its window and its maximum are both 0, and a repeat needs a new requisition.
- Clinical Toxicology Testing allows a single recollection request per order; every other class that recollects allows two.
- **Example (hypothetical).** An Esoteric Reference Testing specimen rejected on a Tuesday is notified to the patient and the ordering provider within 2 business days, by the Thursday of the same week when no holiday intervenes; its class recollection window is 21 calendar days.
